content.text:
Repaired and resubmitted.

**Changes made in response to the verifier:**

1. **Fee cap anchored to a real, defined measure (op 1, §4.2(a)):** the proviso now reads "the Termination Payment shall not exceed the amounts payable to HDI under Section 3.1 for the three (3) months preceding the Termination Date". Section 3.1 (30% of Net Sales above $11,000 per calendar month) is the agreement's own consideration mechanic, so the ceiling is ascertainable and consistent with the retained Net Sales/$800,000 formula, the 4.2(b) zero-floor and the 4.2(c) eight-instalment schedule.

2. **Express Customer convenience right (op 2, §4.1):** added "The Company may also terminate this Agreement for convenience at any time upon ninety (90) days written notice to HDI specifying the Termination Date", so the Customer exit no longer depends on reading the auto-renewal/non-renewal sentence as a convenience right, and the notice ties cleanly into the defined Termination Date used by the cap.

3. **Retained without change:** the mutual 90-day notice (Vendor notice floor, mapped as already met), the HDI end-of-term proviso, the Net Sales formula and all 4.2(b)/(c) machinery — every original word is preserved verbatim.
